question.nlq: Hey! Could you pull up the names of all customers who have ordered a Dell monitor? I'd love to see who's buying from us.

meanings.hidden_knowledge: By 'names' I mean just the first name of each customer.
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_first_name
FROM Products p
JOIN Order_Items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN Orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE p.product_name = 'Dell monitor';
